blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It seems that Vice President Sara Duterte’s office has been consistent in getting flagged by the Commission on Audit (COA) for questionable transactions, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said on Thursday. Luistro, along with other lawmakers, was asked in a press briefing about a COA report on the 2025 Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund, which stated that there were deficiencies or inconsistencies in the documentation of relief efforts conducted by the Office of the Vice President (OVP). COA referred to almost P168 million in public funds used by OVP for relief operations, including inconsistencies in situational reports (sitreps) from the […]...
